builds.name: Reference: Multi-target carry
builds.goal: Reference for Zeri: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile ranged attack carry whose Q is treated as an attack and whose ordinary attack is treated as an ability. Wall travel and sustained R hits create an escalating movement window. Current Q is attack-like while ordinary attacks are ability-like. Verify on-hit and crit interactions on each separately, and record wall travel/R ramp rather than granting both constantly. Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output.
builds.summary: Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output.
testPlan: Kit question for Zeri: Current Q is attack-like while ordinary attacks are ability-like. Verify on-hit and crit interactions on each separately, and record wall travel/R ramp rather than granting both constantly.

Start with the early core (Yun Tal, then Runaan) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Do not assume bolts reproduce every champion effect; isolate the interaction.

The route fails Zeri's stated kit question: Current Q is attack-like while ordinary attacks are ability-like. Verify on-hit and crit interactions on each separately, and record wall travel/R ramp rather than granting both constantly.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Do not assume bolts reproduce every champion effect; isolate the interaction.
Full cost 16,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Yun Tal, then Runaan. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.
